label: TCF3::PBX1

sections.text: TCF3 encodes E2A transcription factors required for lymphoid development.
PBX1 encodes a homeobox transcription factor that cooperates with other developmental regulators.
The t(1;19) fusion joins the TCF3 activation region to the PBX1 homeodomain, creating an abnormal transcription factor. It defines a recurrent B-ALL subtype, often with a pre-B phenotype.

Outcomes have improved with intensive modern ALL therapy; historical adverse-risk estimates should not be applied to current regimens. Adult ELN 2024 describes favorable outcomes with intensive therapy.
